notes.title: 📢 Demo version of Shadow of the Union
notes.content:
📢 Demo version of Shadow of the Union – Coming Soon
Hello survivors!
It’s time to share when you’ll finally be able to try out Shadow of the Union for the first time.


[hr][/hr]

🕹️ Demo (Singleplayer) — Late 2025
We are planning to release the demo by the end of 2025.
⚠️ There’s also a chance it will be part of Steam Fear Fest 2025, which means you might get to play even earlier!


[hr][/hr]

🌐 Multiplayer Beta — Spring–Summer 2026
This will be the first chance to team up with friends and test the co-op survival system.


[hr][/hr]

🚀 Early Access via Discord
Want to try the demo before the official release?
🎟️ Join our Discord community, where we’ll be running:

🔒 Closed playtests

🎁 Key giveaways for early access
